name: codex-workspace-enhancer
description: Native Codex visual workspace with a port-free MCP App and safe local image canvas.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix plugin/codex-workspace-enhancer ci && npx --prefix plugin/codex-workspace-enhancer playwright install chromium
scripts.test:legacy: node --test ./test/*.test.mjs && npm --prefix assets/runtime/enhancer test && npm --prefix assets/runtime/asset-browser test
scripts.quality: npm run quality:native && npm run test:legacy && npm run verify:bundle
